Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly labeled the Latin used around AD 800 (Charlemagne’s era) as “Late Latin.” The correct designation for that period is Medieval Latin (including Carolingian-era Latin). This misclassification led the reasoning toward the wrong target form of the language.
